help pls,
Thanks

if (!is.null(WD)) setwd(WD)

jpeg("myplots.jpg")

for(i in 1:10) {
  y <- rnorm(100)

}

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Re: No display of image
parts:
First try just having plot(x~y) as the last statement in your render function.

When drawing multiple plots you will either need to make them selectable via an input, or use layout (or similar) to construct multiple plots in a single plot area.

-Alex
